fact: Since 2016 chief nurses of health facilities have been trained and given logins to enter monthly data directly in the Senegal DHIS2, and completeness of facility reporting rose from 84.5 per cent in 2014 to 97.5 per cent in 2017.
title: A data quality assessment of the first four years of malaria reporting in the Senegal DHIS2, 2014–2017
